sect1.title: DOM
sect1.para: A Document Object Model for storing and working of tree for HTML and XML documents. It defines a tree with preorder depth first traversal order.

sect2.title: What exactly is it ??
sect2.para: Basically, it is a tree implementation strictly abiding to the rules of the DOM STANDARD defined by an organization named WhatWG.
It is the intermediate which is created when HTML is parsed.
So let's understand this clearly ! In broader sense:-

When we load a website, its HTML, CSS and JS is fetched and every component is parsed.
First HTML is parsed and DOM ( Document Object Model ) tree is created !
Then CSS is parsed and CSSOM ( CSS Object Model ) is created !
Both the DOM and CSSOM are combined to create the Render Tree !
Finally using the Render Tree, we see the website on the screen after some processes of layout, painting , compositing, etc..

blockquote.para: This repository implements the DOM tree for the HTML parsing !

sect2.title: Interesting Fact
sect2.para:
There are so many browsers in the world like Google Chrome, Brave, Microsoft Edge, Firefox,etc.. but how is it that a website looks the same on all of them ???
Reason This is possible because of the standards that all browsers or specifically rendering engines follow ! And that's what we are doing here, following the DOM Standard by WhatWG !
